senses.gloss: m. (פִּרְכֵּס I) painting, dyeing the hair; trnsf. giving a fraudulent appearance, deception.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:5">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ דאדם מאי היא</he> what is (in a legal sense) deception in selling a human being? (Answ. dyeing a slave’s hair). Y. ib. IV, end, 9ᵈ <he>יש פירק׳ בכלים</he> (not <he>כאוכלין</he>) giving a deceptive appearance to garments is forbidden <cite ref="Ketubot 17a:2">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לא פ׳</he> there is no paint (deception), v. <cite ref="K00238"><he>כּוֹחָל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a:11">Snh. 14ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="Q00863"><he>פירכס</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
